A '''Sith Lord''' lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], and was known for being particularly irate. After an [[Unidentified Imperial officer (colonel)|officer]] acquired a promotion to [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] through family influence rather than experience, the officer's actions were brought to the attention of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="TOR" />
